channel.title: The Grant Desk - Writers, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Writers, Canada, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Briarpatch Magazine: AI Resistance Issue, Winter 2027 Call for Pitches
item.description: Briarpatch Magazine · deadline 18 Sep 2026 · CAD 150 for profiles, short essays, book reviews and parting shots (under ~1,500 words); CAD 250 for feature stories and photo essays; CAD 350 for research-based articles and investigative reporting (2,000-2,500 words). No pitch fee.
